summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd, an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed a 6-K reporting the September 17, 2026 issuance of a sixth convertible promissory note to an institutional holder under its existing June 26, 2025 securities purchase agreement. The note carries a $600,000 principal amount sold for $540,000 cash (90%), matures in 28 months, pays 4% interest (14% on default), and converts into ordinary shares at the lower of $1.420 or 88% of the 20-day VWAP, floored at $0.284, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap. A 448,359-share warrant at $1.420, expiring in 66 months, was also issued. Remaining SPA capacity is $87.4 million; proceeds fund working capital. The financing is a routine issuer-level capital commitment rather than a special situation, though the variable conversion floor, non-recourse feature, and warrant overhang warrant dilution monitoring.
